review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies frontend development guidelines, transitioning the main application from Quill to LemonUI, while reserving Quill for MCP and desktop-specific use cases.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: P1.F1.H1 removes the instruction to use quill for menus in the main app and replaces it with LemonUI, while P1.F2.H1 updates the discovery checklist and component recommendation table to use LemonUI instead of quill.
observations.code_quote: - Frontend (quill vs LemonUI): LemonUI is the default in the main app. Use quill for menus, comboboxes, and autocompletes (`DropdownMenu`, `Combobox`, `Autocomplete` from `@posthog/quill`), with the trigger styled to match the surrounding scene's existing UI (LemonButton / ButtonPrimitive). Don't add new `LemonMenu` or `lib/ui/DropdownMenu` (Radix) menus — those are legacy. Don't mix quill and Lemon components within one component's internals. Quill uses Base UI's `render` prop, not Radix's `asChild` — don't carry `asChild` over when converting
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies frontend development guidelines for the main application, directing developers to use LemonUI components instead of quill, which is designated for MCP and desktop apps.
